question: Which of the following has discovered the sea route to India 1498?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vasco Da Gama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In order to reach India and establish a maritime passage from** Europe to the East,** the **Portuguese explorer, Vasco da Gama set off from Lisbon in the year 1497**.
 
• The** sea route to India **was found by **Vasco da Gama **in **1498**.
 
• His expedition made **multiple stops in Africa until arriving at the trading town of Calicut, India, in May 1498**, after sailing down the western coast of Africa and c**ircumnavigating the Cape of Good Hope**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• One of the men who helped** establish British supremacy in India** was **Clive Lord, the first British governor of the Bengal Presidency**.
 
• By **opening up new trade routes and creating connections** amongst various populations, **Henry the sailor **contributed to creating the modern world.
 
• The** early 17th century sea explorer and navigator Captain Hudson **was most remembered for his discoveries of what is now** Canada and parts of the northeastern United States**.
